_about: Public-domain James Baldwin Brown (1820-1884), Congregational minister of Brixton, for the Word Hoard: Aids to the Development of the Divine Life (1861), The Soul's Exodus and Pilgrimage (1862), The Divine Treatment of Sin (1864), The Home Life in the Light of its Divine Idea (1867), Idolatries Old and New (1867), Misread Passages of Scripture (1869), The Divine Mysteries (1869), The Sunday Afternoon (1871), First Principles of Ecclesiastical Truth (1871), The Higher Life (1874) and The Doctrine of Annihilation in the Light of the Gospel of Love (1875), from Internet Archive scans. His father James Baldwin Brown (1785-1843), the lawyer and biographer of Howard, is another man. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 58 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
